description: Source code for the 'bidi' package providing bidirectional text support, including types and functions for handling text direction, paragraph processing, and run ordering.

classes.name: Paragraph
classes.description: Represents a paragraph for bidirectional processing, holding text, types, and options.

classes.name: Ordering
classes.description: Holds the visual ordering of text runs within a paragraph.

classes.name: Run
classes.description: Represents a continuous sequence of characters with a single direction.

methods.name: DefaultDirection
methods.description: Sets the default text direction for a paragraph.

methods.name: SetBytes
methods.description: Configures a Paragraph with byte slice input, processing only up to a paragraph separator.

methods.name: SetString
methods.description: Configures a Paragraph with string input, processing only up to a paragraph separator.

methods.name: Direction
methods.description: Returns the overall direction of the paragraph.

methods.name: IsLeftToRight
methods.description: Checks if the paragraph's principle direction is left-to-right.

methods.name: RunAt
methods.description: Returns the run at a specific position in the text.

methods.name: Order
methods.description: Computes the visual ordering of all text runs in a paragraph.

methods.name: Line
methods.description: Computes the visual ordering of runs for a line segment within the paragraph.

methods.name: Direction
methods.description: Returns the direction of the ordering.

methods.name: NumRuns
methods.description: Returns the number of runs in the ordering.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Returns a specific run within the ordering.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns the text of a run in original order.

methods.name: Bytes
methods.description: Returns the byte representation of a run in original order.

methods.name: Direction
methods.description: Returns the direction of the run.

methods.name: Pos
methods.description: Returns the start and end position of the run within the text.

methods.name: AppendReverse
methods.description: Reverses characters in input bytes, replaces brackets, and appends to output.

methods.name: ReverseString
methods.description: Reverses characters in a string, replacing brackets with their counterparts.
